text: ∀x (Waterfall(x) ↔ (NaturalFeature(x) ∧ ∃y (Water(y) ∧ FlowsOver(y, x) ∧ (VerticalDrop(x) ∨ SeriesOfSteepDrops(x))) ∧ (MountainousArea(x) ∨ AlongRiver(x)))) ::: A waterfall is a natural feature where water flows over a vertical drop or a series of steep drops, often found in mountainous areas or along rivers.
